requirement.description: The next_token function has several issues with token recognition and incomplete token handling. Some test cases fail because the function doesn't correctly identify certain tokens (like NAME, STRING, etc.) or doesn't properly handle incomplete tokens at the end of input.
requirement.contract: The next_token function must correctly identify and return tokens according to PDF syntax rules. For incomplete tokens at end of input, it should return appropriate token types with correct start/end positions. Specifically, it should properly recognize: 1. NAME tokens that end at the end of input 2. TEXT/STRING tokens that end at the end of input 3. HEX_STRING tokens that end at the end of input 4. VALUE tokens (INTEGER/REAL) that end at the end of input 5. KEYWORD tokens that end at the end of input 6. COMMENT tokens that end at the end of input

requirement.description: The parse_obj function has issues with parsing dictionaries and arrays correctly. It doesn't properly handle all the cases for reference objects and nested structures, particularly when dealing with complex nested structures and references.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function must correctly parse PDF objects including: 1. Dictionary objects with proper key-value parsing 2. Array objects with proper element parsing 3. Reference objects (integer 0 R) converted to complex numbers 4. Proper handling of nested dictionaries and arrays 5. Correct handling of different token types in parsing context

requirement.description: The text_string function doesn't correctly handle all text string formats. Specifically, it fails to properly process certain UTF-16BE encoded strings and doesn't correctly handle escape sequences in literal strings.
requirement.contract: The text_string function must correctly handle: 1. Literal strings with proper escape sequence processing 2. Hexadecimal strings with UTF-16BE decoding 3. Proper conversion of PDF text strings to Python strings 4. Handling of various encoding scenarios including Euro symbol and Unicode characters

requirement.description: The next_token function incorrectly handles stream detection and parsing. The function doesn't properly detect and parse stream objects.
requirement.contract: The next_token function must correctly identify and return STREAM tokens with proper start/end positions when encountering stream objects. The function should properly handle the stream start and end markers.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function doesn't properly handle all cases for reference object conversion and array parsing. It also doesn't handle some edge cases correctly.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function must correctly convert reference patterns (integer 0 R) to complex numbers and properly parse all object types. It should handle: 1. Reference objects in arrays and dictionaries 2. Proper conversion of integers to complex numbers (e.g., 6j) 3. Correct parsing of nested structures
